summary: Pull day, so protein is front-loaded with turkey, eggs, and two chicken-based plates. Potato Chicken Creole gives lunch some heat and variety, and smoked ling cod swaps in at dinner for an omega-3 boost alongside more chicken and carbs.

meals.name: Uber Breakfast
meals.note: Turkey and eggs for a solid protein base, a bagel and yogurt for carbs, raspberries for fiber.

meals.name: Uber HQ Lunch
meals.note: Potato Chicken Creole as the main with an extra chicken breast, pasta and bread rounding out the carbs.

meals.name: Uber Pre-workout
meals.note: Wellness-bar protein smoothie plus banana, low fat and easy to digest before lifting.

meals.name: Uber Post-workout / Dinner
meals.note: Smoked ling cod for variety plus extra chicken breast, pasta, sweet potato, bread and black beans to close out protein, carbs and fiber for the day.
